notes:
Inbound from marketing automation webinar sign-up. Team builds a content-generation platform used by 2,200 SMB customers. Looking to replace ad-hoc self-hosted LLMs with a hosted API to 1) reduce ops overhead, 2) get predictable latency, 3) lower per-token costs via batching/caching.

Initial discovery call (02/25) — AE Jordan + SE Priya + CTO Amit. Key quotes: "We need predictable monthly spend; spikes during campaign drops kill margins"; "Batch job for daily variant gen (400k titles/day) — can you handle that throughput?"

Primary constraints: cost-sensitive (target <$0.0008/token average), high burstiness (campaign windows), want automatic prefix caching to reuse common prompt templates, and simple SDK integration for Node/Python. Not yet requiring VPC or on-prem; public cloud only.

Security: SMB customers require SSO for admin UI; ContentCog needs audit logs for admin actions and anonymized request retention for 90 days. Legal asked for short note on residency — they operate in NA only for now.

Internal notes: likely PLG self-serve initially; mid-Q2 could convert to committed monthly if cost forecasts look good. Will run a 2-week POC using hosted API (sample volume ~1M tokens across batches).
